thing-type.label: Generic Bluetooth Device
thing-type.description: A generic bluetooth device that supports GATT characteristics

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: The frequency at which readable characteristics refreshed

parameter.name: alwaysConnected
parameter.label: Connect Automatically
parameter.description: If enabled, will automatically connect to the device and reconnect if connection is lost.

parameter.name: connectionSecurity
parameter.label: Connection Security
parameter.description: How the connection to this device is secured. The encrypted/PIN modes are EXPERIMENTAL and currently honoured only by the Direct-BT adapter (other adapters ignore this). See each option: • None: unencrypted, unbonded — the proven, dead-stable default, suitable for open sensors. • Encrypted: request Just-Works LE encryption (no passkey/MITM). Strict — it never downgrades to unencrypted; if encryption cannot be established it keeps retrying. Use for devices that must never talk unencrypted. • Encrypted with fallback: request encryption, but automatically fall back to an unencrypted connection if the device pairs and then repeatedly fails to reconnect. This happens because of a current limitation — after pairing, some devices switch to a resolvable/identity address that the Bluetooth stack cannot yet resolve on reconnect (bonded reconnect is not fully implemented), so the link would otherwise loop forever. The fallback keeps the device usable; choose this when availability matters more than guaranteed confidentiality. • PIN: authenticated (MITM-protected) pairing using a fixed passkey (set "Passkey (PIN)" below). Fails closed — if the device cannot do authenticated pairing it does NOT connect, never downgrading to a weaker link.

parameter.name: passkey
parameter.label: Passkey (PIN)
parameter.description: The fixed passkey/PIN (0–999999) supplied for authenticated pairing when Connection Security is "PIN". Enter the PIN the device expects. Ignored for the other security modes. Note: this is stored in the Thing configuration; treat it as a secret.

channel-type.label: Unknown Bluetooth Characteristic
channel-type.description: The raw value of unknown characteristics are represented with hexadecimal
